description: §55.1 / §55.10 — the presence validator `is given` takes the Level-1 inline message in the paren form, exactly as `req("…")` does: `<nick is given("…") length(>=3, "…")>` declares the cell (no E-VALIDATOR-INLINE-*, no lost declaration). Typing "ab" leaves a present value, so `is given` passes and `length(>=3)` fails; its inline override renders at `<errors of=>`.
rationale: §55.1 lists `is given` with catalog arity bareword-or-inline-override; §55.10 Level 1 is per-(cell, validator), static-string, paren form. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, validator too, go" (the validator spelled `is given`).

domAnchored.text: Nickname must be at least 3 chars
